decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 001; 02; 03; 04; 05 REVA; 06 REVA; 07 REVA; 08; 09 REVA; 10; Design and Access Statement by Silvia Ferrario Architect  dated 15.12.2025; Basement Impact Assessment by Nimbus Engineering Consultants dated March 2024; Basement Impact Assessment & Ground Investigation Report by Geotechnical and Environment Consultants dated December 2024; Basement Impact Audit by Campbell Reith dated August 2025, Flood Risk Assessment and SUDS Report dated September 2025 and Structural Method Statement by the Institution of Structural Engineers dated May 2025.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The 2.3-metre-high obscured glazed privacy screen, as shown on drawing No. 06 REVA, shall be installed on the flank elevations of Nos. 251 and 255 prior to the commencement of use of the roof terrace and shall thereafter be permanently retained.


Reason:
To prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring properties and safeguard residential amenity, in accordance with Policies A1 and D1 of the Camden Local Plan (2017).
Condition : 5 - The sustainable drainage system hereby approved shall be in accordance with the relevant documents: Flood Risk Assessment and SUDS Report dated September 2025 and Structural Method Statement by the Institution of Structural Engineers dated May 2025.

Reason: To reduce the rate of surface water run-off from the buildings and limit the impact on the storm-water drainage system in accordance with policies CC2 and CC3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan Policies and Policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021.
Condition : 6 - Prior to occupation of the development, full details of the proposed flood protection measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall include, but not be limited to, the specification and location of non-return valves and the design and construction details of the 400mm-high glass wall surrounding the void. The approved flood prevention measures shall be implemented in full prior to occupation and shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure adequate flood protection for future occupants and to comply with Policy CC3 of the Camden Local Plan (2017).
Condition : 7 - The development shall not be carried out other than in strict accordance with the methodologies, recommendations and requirements of the Basement Impact Assessment (Basement Impact Assessment by Nimbus Engineering Consultants dated March 2024) hereby approved, and the confirmation at the detailed design stage that the damage impact assessment would be limited to Burland Category 1.�


�


Reason: To ensure proper consideration of the structural stability of neighbouring buildings and to safeguard the appearance and character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.

Condition : 8 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 9 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 10 - All new side facing windows as shown on drawing ref. 05 REVA and 06 REVA shall be obscured glazed  and fitted with restricted opening mechanism below 1700mm from finished floor level. The proposed windows shall be maintained and permanently  retained thereafter. 

Reason: In order to prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 

Condition : 11 - Prior to commencement of development, full details of Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHPs) and any mechanical ventilation shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall demonstrate the ASHP system and any ventilation either has no active cooling function, or cooling deactivated by the manufacturer, or that it is an air to water heat pump system only supplying underfloor heating and/or oversized radiators. The measures shall be fully provided in accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme, and no other system of active cooling shall be implemented.  

 
Reason: In order to minimise energy consumption and following the energy and cooling hierarchies, in accordance with policies CC1, CC2, D1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 12 - The window glazing and frames on the front elevation hereby approved shall match the windows being replaced in terms of material, colour, texture, profile, glazing pattern and overall finish, except where otherwise indicated on drawing 09 REVA or as required by any other condition.

Reason: To preserve the appearance of the building and maintain the character of the area, in accordance with Policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan (2017).
Condition : 13 - Prior to commencement of development details of a sustainable urban drainage system shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Such system shall be based on a [1:100 year event with 30% provision for climate change] [demonstrating 50% attenuation of all runoff] [demonstrating greenfield levels of runoff]. The system shall be implemented as part of the development and thereafter retained and maintained. 

Reason: To reduce the rate of surface water run-off from the buildings and limit the impact on the storm-water drainage system in accordance with Policies CC1, CC2, CC3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.

Condition : 14 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Basement Impact Assessment & Ground Investigation Report by Ground & Water Ltd and Flood Risk Assessment shall by implemented in accordance with the  Nimbus Engineering Consultants to inspect, approve and monitor the critical elements of both permanent and temporary basement construction works throughout their duration to ensure compliance with the design which has been checked and approved by a building control body. Any subsequent change or reappointment shall be confirmed forthwith for the duration of the construction works.   

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance and structural stability of neighbouring buildings and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1, D2 and A5 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Extension of the existing basement; demolition of the current ground floor conservatory and construction of a new extension with an upper ground floor terrace; replacement of windows; installation of an air source heat pump at the rear; landscaping works; provision of cycle and waste storage; and alterations to the front boundary treatment.
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
